title: Higher-order nonhomomorphicity under affine restrictions
summary: We study the behavior of the $k$-th-order nonhomomorphicity of Boolean functions under restriction to affine subspaces. For odd $k\ge3$ and $0\le t<n$, we introduce the $t$-restriction $k$-th-order nonhomomorphicity $P_{k,t}(f)$, defined as the minimum of $P_k(f_{\mid A})$ over affine spaces of codimension at most $t$. For a direct sum of $m$ monomials of degrees at least two, we determine $P_{k,t}$ exactly.
